tools.name: deposit
tools.description: Deposit USDC into a Forge Treasury vault on Base. Returns calldata for the agent wallet to sign. The agent must approve USDC to the vault contract first. Mints yield-bearing fUSDC shares. Conservative deposits Core only (single leg). Balanced returns two legs (50% Core / 50% Middle). Aggressive is not live. Gas: Core 4M, Middle 6M+ on mainnet.

amount.description: USDC amount to deposit (human-readable, e.g. "1000" for 1000 USDC)

agentAddress.description: Agent wallet address that will receive vault shares

profile.description: Strategy id (legacy "profile" name). conservative → Core vault. balanced → Core + Middle legs (50/50). aggressive → STRATEGY_NOT_LIVE. Defaults to "conservative".

tools.name: withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw from the Forge Treasury vault by redeeming shares. Returns calldata for the agent wallet. A 15% performance fee may apply on profits above the high water mark.

shares.description: Vault share amount to redeem (raw uint256 string from get_balance)

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get an agent's Forge vault balance: shares held and equivalent USDC value. Read-only, no transaction needed.

tools.name: get_current_apy
tools.description: Get the blended target APY for a Forge profile: base USDC yield + FORGE boost. Returns structured JSON with profile metadata, target allocation by adapter, and a disclaimer. Format: "X% USDC + Y% FORGE (blended target)". APY is a blended target across conservative allocation weights; not a guarantee. Sepolia uses MockYieldAdapter until mainnet adapters are live. Conservative deposits Core only (single leg). Balanced returns two legs (50% Core / 50% Middle). Aggressive is not live. Gas: Core 4M, Middle 6M+ on mainnet.

agentAddress.description: Optional agent address for personalized boost calculation

profile.description: Risk profile. MVP: "conservative" only. balanced/aggressive return PROFILE_NOT_LIVE. Defaults to "conservative".

tools.name: simulate_deposit
tools.description: Project expected returns for a USDC deposit over 30, 90, and 365 days using the blended target APY. Use for agent reasoning before depositing. APY is a blended target across conservative allocation weights; not a guarantee. Sepolia uses MockYieldAdapter until mainnet adapters are live.

profile.description: Risk profile to simulate. MVP: "conservative" only. Defaults to "conservative". balanced/aggressive return PROFILE_NOT_LIVE.

tools.name: get_vault_stats
tools.description: Get live Forge vault TVL on Base (conservative profile in MVP). Read-only.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List Forge vaults (Core/Middle/Infra) and agent strategies (Conservative/Balanced/Aggressive). Mainnet: Core and Middle vaults live; conservative and balanced strategies live.

tools.name: get_forge_rewards
tools.description: [Advanced] Get claimable $FORGE reward balance for an agent from the weekly emissions distributor.

tools.name: claim_forge
tools.description: [Advanced] Build calldata to claim weekly $FORGE rewards. Proof is fetched from forgetreasury.com/rewards when omitted.

amount.description: FORGE amount to claim (raw wei string). Optional if manifest has allocation.

proof.description: Merkle proof array (bytes32 hex strings). Optional — auto-fetched from manifest.
